quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Mike Brown's extensive experience makes him the better coach
quotes.excerpt: I got to go with Mike Brown just based off the fact he is so well traveled in the NBA.
quotes.quote: I got to go with Mike Brown just based off the fact he is so well traveled in the NBA. He has seen everything. He has done everything. He was the head coach when they won a championship, but he still got a ring with Golden State. He has had players like Kobe Bryant, he has had LeBron James. He has seen it all. And he has led the Knicks to the finals, something that Tom Thibodeau couldn't do.
